snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Mii Fighter Costumes #8 - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The next group of Mii Fighter costumes is available now in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate! Battle against Sephiroth with Barret (Gunner), Tifa (Brawler), and Aerith (Swordfighter) costumes. Add a little feathery flare with a Chocobo Hat as well! Geno, from Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars, will be joining as a Mii Fighter costume as well. The Warrior from Star Road’s costume will be for the Gunner Mii Fighter.
